headlines.text: Fed's Oct. 27-28 minutes show nearly all officials see another rate hike as likely, with Waller pushing for a 50bp move in December and AI-driven demand flagged as a fresh inflation risk; markets now price ~95% odds of a December hike
Wall Street slips Wednesday afternoon (Dow -0.7% to ~50,390) as the dollar hits a 19-month high and traders digest the hawkish Fed minutes alongside Nvidia's post-earnings slide

Anthropic set to price its IPO Wednesday night above $80 a share (topping its $70-$78 range) on roughly $500B of investor demand, valuing the AI firm above $1.4 trillion ahead of Thursday's Nasdaq debut as ANT
Target's Q3 comparable sales jump 5.6% (vs. ~3.6% est.) with EPS of $2.65 as turnaround accelerates; shares climb premarket and full-year guidance raised

Nvidia shares fall for a fifth straight session despite blowout Q3 revenue of $115.8B (+103% YoY) as investors keep digesting interim CEO Colette Kress's rocky first earnings call since Jensen Huang's exit
Lowe's Q3 sales jump 9.3% (comps +1.8%) with adjusted EPS of $3.10, a sixth straight quarter of positive comps under CEO Marvin Ellison; shares surge ~6% premarket and full-year outlook raised
